title: Sarcastic Exclamations and Mock Reactions
goal: Deliver sarcastic exclamations and mock emotional reactions with the subjunctive

items: I can use mock emotional reactions like *¡Me encanta que...!* and *¡Qué maravilla que...!* with the subjunctive.
I can recognise and use fixed sarcastic exclamations like *¡Qué casualidad!*, *¡Qué gracia!*, *¡A buena hora!* and *¡Faltaría más!*.
I can keep the subjunctive intact even when the emotional reaction is ironic.
